statement: I don't just build software. I study how software is designed, estimated and evolved.
intro: The areas below describe what I do as an engineering capability, not as a list of technologies.

capabilities.title: Software Architecture
capabilities.text: Design and evolution of complex systems, APIs, data models and integration strategies.

capabilities.title: Full-Stack Engineering
capabilities.text: Backend, frontend and database development focused on maintainability and long-term evolution.

capabilities.title: Mobile Engineering
capabilities.text: Flutter applications for Android and iOS, including APIs, authentication and institutional services.

capabilities.title: Legacy Evolution
capabilities.text: Reverse engineering, modernization and incremental evolution of existing systems.

capabilities.title: Technical Leadership
capabilities.text: Architecture decisions, development standards, mentoring and technical coordination.

capabilities.title: Software Engineering
capabilities.text: Estimation, process design, automation and engineering methodologies.
